comment: Dr. Mayes singlehandedly made me decide to major in Health Studies. He is my favorite professor at U of R and I can tell he will be instrumental in helping with my future plans. He cares deeply about you and about the material, tying in heavy but fascinating topics. I can't say anything negative about him, and you should take this class!!

dr mayes is such a nice dude. he cares about you sm beyond just grades and is willing to extend a helping hand whenever he can. hes one of the professors on campus that actually gets to know you and it shows. his lectures are entertaining and the midterm and final were very straightforward (u also get a cheat sheet)

Dr. Mayes is an amazing professor. His lectures are sooo interesting and he makes the once/week 2.5 hour class very engaging (also ended early almost every class). HW is very light, a couple readings/videos every week. Go meet with him outside of class too, he's a great advisor. Definitely take his class!
Everyone told me Dr. Mayes is the best and I'm here to tell you that Dr. Mayes is, in fact, the best. Regardless of what you're planning on majoring in, take a class with Dr. Mayes. He's epic.

I love Dr. Mayes! He is intelligent and kind to all of his students! I feel like I had my parent as my professor at times. He is interested in the success of his students and wants everyone to thrive. His lectures are super interesting, and he engages with the class. The weekly SAR papers and the midterm were easy! HIGHLY recommend he is amazing.

Dr. Mayes is literally the best! Don't think I would have survived my first semester at UR without him. Class is easy and engaging, SAR papers suck but they're easy grade inflaters. I would take any class if he was the professor.

TAKE DR MAYES IF YOU DO NOTHING ELSE AT THIS GODFORSAKEN SCHOOL he is incredibly caring and passionate about what he teaches. He cares about each and every student and will find opportunities to help you and keep up with you throughout your time at UR. Could not recommend a professor more he is absolutely one of the best people I have met here.
If you do one thing at this school, take his class. He is like a father to all of his students and his classes are super interesting!
Dr. Mayes is a G. Super easy to get an A as long as you do the homework and pay attention during class. Incredible guy.

This was by far the best class I've ever taken. Prof. Mayes was incredibly knowledgable about every single subject we discussed in class, and I feel like he taught in a way that actually made the information stick. I would recommend him to everyone at UR, regardless of their major.
A lot SARC papers but based on completion. The midterm was not hard.

Love Mr. Mayes. Take his class. More work than other FYS (not hard just long b/c vids & articles) but so worth it because you learn so much and everything assigned is interesting (and this is coming from someone who is not interested in policy). He is interested in hearing what people have to say in HW & discussions and is a good teacher & person.

It is clear that Professor Mayes cares about his students a lot and he is very invested in each of his students. His classes are super engaging and he teaches about things that matter even past the scope of the coursework. I would highly recommend taking Professor Mayes' class to anybody!

Dr. Mayes is fantastic and if you are interested in global public health you should definitely take his class. He is the most passionate and engaging professor I've had at UR. The workload is mild compared to other FYS classes and it is relatively easy to get an A. He is also super responsive and will help you whenever you need it.

Mayes is a good professor, but SO many writing assignments every week plus long essays on the midterm and the final exam is a long research paper. Writing all the SARC papers was annoying but at least it never felt like busy work. I wouldn't have learned nearly as much if I hadn't written them.
The most amazing professor at U of R. He is the most caring and amazing man ever.

LOVE this man. Dr. Mayes is by far the most caring professor and faculty member I know at this school. This class was super interesting and the teaching method was extremely efficient and not too challenging! Only 2 tests, and Dr. Mayes allowed us to do the midterm open notes and pre-write our essay for the final! Definitely recommend!!!!

Truly such a gem. By far my favorite professor at UR. He is incredibly flexible with due dates in special circumstances, and he is a very fair grader. He is incredibly receptive to his student's feedback and is always striving to educate his students without putting undue stress on them. The only homework is weekly summary papers 1-2 pages. 10/10

Professor Mayes is a gem. He was very flexible with due dates and often gifted us extensions. His required readings helped us to learn the material in a manner that was engaging and interesting. There are daily papers due, but they are easy reflection based papers and he gives a ton of feedback on them and truly enjoys hearing from his students.

Professor Mayes is probably the best teacher that I had during the semester that I took HCS100. Very caring teacher who cares about the material that he teaches. He only gave two tests the entire semester though, which means that you have to spend a lot of time studying for each test. Overall, he is a phenomenal teacher and an even kinder person.

Dr. Mayes is a great professor for HCS. The only problem is that he enjoys teaching HIS OWN politics, which is great if you agree, but horrible if you have other political values. He also kinda judges and makes fun of some belief systems in the US which isn't right. Nonetheless, he's a good professor and a good person.

Dr. Mayes will be THE BEST professor you ever have. Took HCS 100 with him, and it was the best class I have ever taken. He is so supportive and caring for all students. Assigned lots of engaging articles, brought in students who shared their professional experiences, made class lectures fun! I learned so much and had the best time doing it. 10/10.

TAKE DR. MAYES!!! Seriously. He is my favorite professor by far, and I havent met a single person who doesnt like him or his teaching. He is an incredible professor who goes above and beyond for each of his students. The homework can seem like a lot, but the material is interesting so its not that bad. He makes his lectures fun and entertaining!

Dr. Mayes is a rare gem. He makes class exciting and is passionate about the material he covers. If you have the opportunity to take his class, you absolutely must. More than anything, he cares about the wellbeing of his students and wants them to succeed. He will do anything and everything he can to be an advocate and support system for students
Dr. Mayes is an amazing professor! He truly cares about his students. Lectures were very interesting, and I always looked forward to class. Would highly recommend!

Professor Mayes is an absolute GEM, you are missing out if you don't take his class. He is kind, funny, smart and he really cares about his students. This class should be mandatory to graduate from college because every adult needs to know how the health care system works and the many flaws that it has. I would take this course again if I could.

He always comes into class sweating and panting from his exercise. I have him for two and a half hours straight on Fridays, and I have no trouble staying engaged the whole time. Whether you are pre-med, a poli-sci kid, or an SJW you will love this class with this man. Homework is just two-page summary/response to the reading. NO BOOK!

Dr. Mayes took time to get to know his 100+ students through meetings and short paper assignments. Grade was basically determined by the combo of midterm and final. Because of Dr. Mayes and his inspirational, emotion and thought provoking lectures, I looked forward to each class period. You would regret skipping his class, it's that great!
The best overall professor I have had at UR. Very passionate about his teaching, and has amazing lectures.
Dr. Mayes is rightfully known as one of the best professors at UR. He is really passionate about the content and gives the best lectures. He really cares about his students.

Dr. Mayes is hands down one of my favorite professors I've ever had! He's truly inspirational and cares about all his students, not just in the classroom but outside as well. It's super easy to talk to him about what's going on, and he's definitely a professor everyone should take at one point or another.
Known as one of the best professors on campus. He was by far the best professor I have had so far.

Dr. Mayes is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He really cares about his students, expects a lot, but is understanding. Had him for SSIR, and he not only assigned SUPER interesting stuff to read, but he went over it all in class and made it super clear. This man is a saint! He will mentor and write recs for you until the end of time!

Professor Mayes is one of the best professors I have ever taken. He loves what he teaches, and it really shows. Graded just by few papers and a final. Rick loves to get to know his students, and he'll make sure he does everything he can to give you a stress-free class. One mental health day a month, and constantly checks in with students.
Best professor at UR! Take him for whatever class he teaches!

Dr. Mayes is hands down the best professor at this University, so take one of his classes if you ever get the chance. Even if you don't need the credit. Just do it. You won't regret it. He truly cares about hi students and their futures and will bend over backward to make sure you succeed not only in his class but in life in general.

Professor Mayes is arguably one of the best professors at the University of Richmond. He gives amazing lectures on relevant topics to healthcare in a objective manner. Doing the readings just makes class that much more engaging. I would take him again if I could. He is no walk in the park but the benefits of his class is well worth the investment
THIS man changed my life. Take him for HCS100 and you'll fall in love with the class+him (and even change your major).   Beware: you may disagree on him with some topics if you're not very liberal.
Most people like him, and he's generally agreeable, but if you don't agree with him good luck doing well. Brought inappropriate and unprofessional opinions into classroom.
we need more professors like mayes on campus.

This man changed my life. I owe my career prospects and most of my formative college experiences to him. He cares so much about his job and his students, and he revels in opportunities to take learning outside of the classroom. If you ever get the chance to take a class with him at UR, do NOT hesitate. But you get out what you put in.

Dr. Mayes is extremely encouraging and helpful! The lectures and readings that he selected for Healthcare Class exposed me to so much that I was unaware of. You will learn an incredible amount of information from this course.

Took his graduate Intro. to U.S. Healthcare at UVA and really liked it. Great prep for med school interviews, health care consulting and health administration. Cares about his students and making the LONG 3-hour classes worthwhile and engaging. Do make sure you come to class prepared though!

Great professor, lots of you-tube videos which you can tell he lovveeess. He made methods my favorite class by far. No h/w just a midterm and final but COME TO CLASS OR YOU WILL NOT BE PREPARED FOR HIS EXAMS.
Never had a better professor. Highly recommended whether you want to minor in Medical Humanities or not. You will enjoy the class just because he makes it that much better.

Dr. Mayes is a phenomenal professor...one of my favorites here at UR! He is extremely helpful and kind to everybody in the class. He's a great lecturer and the material is fascinating. Make sure you keep up with the reading...you DO have to do all of it if you want to do well! Highly recommended... I hope to have another class of his!!
Dude gives lots of pop quizzes for Methods...nuff said.

I took Mayes for Public Policy, Research Methods and Health Care.  Great guy, very passionate and willing to help you do well.  Not the hardest grader, but assigns a LOT of reading that you HAVE to keep up with. Really went out of his way to make Methods bearable, which I appreciated.

This course is one of the most valuable classes offered at the UR. The global burden of disease is one of the most life-altering facts that most Americans know very little about. I think classes like these should be a requirement rather than Core or Wellness. The Peru trip was so amazing and I didn´t even mind that class met on Friday nights!

I took him for both Intro. to Public Policy and U.S. Healthcare. He is amazing. He really cares about the students and is passionate about the subject matter. The midterm and final are both very fair. No other tests! Most of the readings are fascinating.

This course was incredibly helpful when interviewing at Medical Schools. Dr. Mayes obviously really loves teaching the class. It fills up instantly, goes 3 hours on Thursday nights, and covers just about anything and everything having to do with health care in one semester. My roommate even came to some classes they were so interesting.

VERY VERY intense class in terms of reading load, debates and mandatory do****entaries. But you learn a ton about microeconomics, health care, education, finance, taxes, and other issues that every college student should know about.

Best Professor at Richmond. His enthusiasm and love for everything healthcare is contagious. He doesn't use textbooks, but instead assigns 6-7 great bestselling novels. The workload can be very intense, and at times the class can be emotionally draining, but in the end you'll come out knowing more than you ever imagined possible.

Amazing class! Met FRIDAY nights 5-9 and nobody missed. Dr. Mayes and his wife took us to Peru over spring break to do research, which was an incredable experience. The kind of class that changes your career plans.

I love this man! He expects a lot from his students but gives a lot in return. His pation for the subject is contagious. He is packed with energy. Overall one of my favorite teachers. a lot of reading but only 3 major assignments (you NEED to keep up with the reading on your own).

Absolutely essential class for anyone planning on or even thinking about a career in a health-related profession (doctor, nurse, hospital administrator, etc). Covers everything from health insurance to infectious diseases, pediatrics, history of medicine, Paul Farmer and much more (TOO much in fact, should be a 2-semester course or even a minor)!

Dr. Mayes is one of the best profs at UR! He is very passionate about teaching and really cares about his students' understanding. Mayes does assign a lot of reading, but it's worth it. Dr. Mayes is an amazing professor. Definitely take him if you get the chance!

beware: one of the best profs at UR but also insane. intro class and yet we had to read 7 books, watch 10-15 Frontline documentaries on our own time...i lost track along the way, AND write a long research paper. emailed us almost an article or news briefing a day. loved the course, but it should be an upper-level one and 4 credits at that.

Sick class! Way way too much reading and emotionally draining, especially toward the end. But yet sooo very worth it. Take P/F if you can because Mayes basically combines 3 courses into one: history of medicine, health economics and policy, and int'l public health. Great prof but sometimes seems to forget that we also have other classes.

Mayes is the most informative, energetic, knowledgable professor I have had. Readings are very interesting and class discussions were great. Can get anyone interested in the subject matter. Grading a bit tough but not many grades, but will learn more than any other class.

Mayes is a great guy who will make class very interesting. You will never fall asleep in his class. The first half of the semester you will have a relatively light workload. However, the second half, especially toward the end, you will have a massive workload. No busy work though, everything he teaches is relevant and interesting. Take his class!!!

One of the most energetic profs you can have.  Loves the material and you will enjoy it also after taking his class.  Not many grades, and tests/paper are hard, but class was fun and mayes is a real good guy.
Rick Mayes is THE MAN. I love this guy. Class is awesome, the stuff we read is GREAT. Couldn't ask for more, definetly want to take more classes with him.

Dr. Mayes truly cares about his students and their opinions.  He is my favorite professor and I highly recommend his public policy class to anyone.  Im not interested in majoring in poly sci, but the class has taught me so much about the real world and the books we have to read are great, especially blink and freakonomics.
As mentioned below, the ABSOLUTE best prep for med school interviews and for going into health care in general
Great Prof, very good at creating interest in topic.Also knows how to challenge us
makes class interesting, good to talk to
heavy reading load, but makes class so interesting and relevent to our lives

Can we say full of ourself?  That is what this man his.  He is too caught up on his old days at UR in SigEp and his class favorites to teach anything.  One of the worst in the poli-sci department.  He is not UR prof material!

Extremely demanding class with tons of reading and research requirements, but also very fun.  His passion for all things "health care" is contagious.  He often pushes too hard (sometimes he forgets that we have other classes).  But he really seems to want his students to get A's and B's.
Heavy, borderline ridiculous workload, but not the hardest grader.  If you're pre-med, take Dr. Mayes's health care class.  It's the best prep for med school interviews.
Frat dude becomes professor, but still a frat dude at heart.
actually made me enjoy learning research methods/social stats
this dude just doesn't get the real world.   easy and energetic, but utterly clueless.

Amazing teacher!  Best in the department.  Really cares about his students in and out of the classroom.  Makes class fun and poignant.  You will probably have to work for your grade but if you don't do well it definitely isn't his fault.
I love Dr. Mayes!! His classes are the best and you can tell he actually cares about what he is teaching and makes sure the lessons are interesting and relevant.
Amazing professor- extremely engaging (and I had his class at 8:15), tons of work, but fair grader.
Best professor I've ever had. Goes above & beyond for his students... overall a great guy.
Best teacher in the school hands down
cares more about what he does and his students than any other prof i've ever had
